cohort: Seven COVID-19 patients treated with ECMO in an ICU
finding: ECMO is a lifesaving treatment option for severe COVID-19 patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome who do not respond to conventional treatments.
mod_finding: Three patients underwent cesarean section (two before ECMO, one during) and all delivered prematurely (35, 32, and 27 weeks), with all newborns discharged in good health.
gest_age: Three cesarean deliveries at 35, 32, and 27 weeks
